verdict.rationale: The vendor documents self-hosting with Docker and a downloadable desktop app that runs "on your device in minutes." Community users corroborate the speed: one had it running in under 5 minutes, and another installed it easily on a standard office PC. One Linux user hit a chrome-sandbox permission error that needed a manual fix. Missing for 10: the actual one-line install command (docker run or installer script) quoted in the evidence, and a clean install path on Linux without a manual permission workaround.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, I can install the assistant on my own machine with one documented command — installer script, npm/pip package, or Docker image — and reach a working chat in minutes

citations.quote: Download AnythingLLM and get a privacy-focused, extensible, and capable AI agent running on your device in minutes.
Another user called it super easy for less technical folks and had it running in under 5 minutes.
called the single-install desktop packaging very slick
